An '''attack''' was made on the home of one of the [[Unidentified Sienar Fleet Systems board member|board members]] of the [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] design company by rebel [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorists]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The rebels were searching for schematics for prototypes of the [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] of [[Starfighter/Legends|vessels]] which Sienar designed for the Empire, hoping that they could identify weaknesses in the future products. During the attack, the [[MI-series security droid]], [[MI-726]], who had been assigned to the board member to defend his home, went rogue and abandoned its master and his house, fleeing the scene.<ref name="BTDF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The attack was created as part of "[[Bounties to Die For]]," an article in the [[Star Wars Gamer 6|sixth]] issue of [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine series,<ref name="BTDF" /> which was published [[September 4]], [[2001]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/rpg/news20010815.html|text=Hunting Down ''Gamer'' #6}}</ref> The magazines were supplements for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'', and the attack was included as part of an entry on MI-726 written by [[S. Mitch Ritchie]]. The article only states that the [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]] are posted by the Empire but does not give a specific era in which they are set.<ref name="BTDF" />
